method: Built-in image generation; original assets generated from descriptions, not commercial reference-image edits

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: monochrome optical scattering texture for a professional cinematic lens-flare compositor, not a complete flare preset. Create ONE original physically plausible on-axis white point-light scattering field, photographed through a slightly imperfect vintage cinema lens against absolute RGB black. Square image. Exactly centered tiny soft saturated-white luminous core, surrounded by a creamy diffused neutral-grey aureole and highly irregular feathery light scatter. Many extremely faint wispy rays vary greatly in length, width and angular spacing, overlap into a soft veil; a handful of longer faint diffraction rays. Subtle optical microstructure, gentle uneven illumination. The visible scatter occupies the middle 70 percent of the canvas and fades completely into pure black on all four edges, generous empty black margin. The central white hotspot diameter is about 3 percent of frame width. At 15 percent radius the halo is medium grey; outside 35 percent radius essentially black. It should resemble an unretouched real optical test frame, not a radial blur filter. STRICT: no evenly spaced spoke wheel, no dandelion, no fiber-optic ball, no bright tips, no individual sparkles or dust particles, no circular rims or rings, no ghost chain, no horizontal anamorphic streak, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark, no colors. Natural photographic imperfection without smoky swirls or material surfaces. Black background is required for additive compositing.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ONE monochrome cinema lens reflection element on pure RGB black, square image, for additive compositing. An original photographed on-axis internal lens ghost: one large circular defocused aperture pupil, centered, diameter 68 percent of canvas. Its interior is dark translucent grey with subtle mottled optical density, not uniformly filled. A delicate soft uneven outer grey rim, barely visible in places, with an irregular brighter arc at the lower-left. Inside the pupil, a second MUCH smaller round focused reflection, diameter 13 percent of canvas, very slightly below center, with an asymmetrically bright soft rim and a tiny concentrated white knot inside. Fine natural optical density and subtly curved caustic traces, extremely restrained. Outer pupil peak medium grey, central focus bright white; the interior mostly nearly black. Photographic lens-test realism, no stylized glow effects, no hard vector outlines, no glowing soap bubble, no 3D globe, no shards, no starburst, no diamond or triangular facets, no swirling galaxy, no lens housing, no source sun, no sparkle particles, no ghost chain, no text or watermark. Generous pure black 15 percent margin on every side. This is a dim lens pupil with a small internal focus, not a full flare composition. Greyscale only, black background, no transparency.

limits: Authored appearance textures. Not measured scatter or optical transmission.
